transcript.text: Hi, I'm Priya from HDFC Bank's infosec team. We're evaluating Smallest AI for our collections use case.
Hi, this is the Smallest AI security team. How can I help you today?
Hi, this is the Smallest AI security team. How can I help you today?
What security certifications do you hold?
We hold ISO/IEC 27001:2022, SOC 2 Type II, and PCI DSS compliance. We do not currently hold HIPAA, FedRAMP, or StateRAMP certifications. Would you like the specific details for any of those?
Do you have PCI DSS compliance?
Yes, we are PCI DSS compliant. Our payment card data handling is fully aligned with PCI DSS requirements. I can have our team send the compliance documentation to you via email if you'd like.
Can you share your SOC 2 report?
I can have our team send that to you. What's the best email address? We'll send it from security@smallest.ai, usually within the same business day.
